grades.quote: When RPLV=0, the page table entry can be accessed by any program whose privilege level is not lower than PLV; when RPLV=1, the page table entry can only be accessed by programs whose privilege level is equal to PLV.
grades.reason: The LA64 TLBRELO table defines RPLV for a page table entry. RPLV=0 lets any program with privilege level not lower than PLV access the entry. RPLV=1 restricts access to programs whose privilege level equals PLV. This directly answers how RPLV changes the privilege check.
